what is a nurse.a: A nurse is a healthcare professional who provides patient care, monitors health conditions, and supports treatment and recovery.

what is a hospital.a: A hospital is a healthcare facility that provides medical treatment, diagnosis, surgery, emergency care, and other services.

what is a medicine.a: Medicine is a substance or treatment used to prevent, diagnose, relieve, or treat a health condition.

what is an antibiotic.a: An antibiotic is a medicine used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

what is a painkiller.a: A painkiller is a medicine used to reduce or relieve pain.

what is sleep paralysis.a: Sleep paralysis is a temporary state in which a person is conscious but unable to move or speak while falling asleep or waking up.

why do people sneeze.a: People sneeze when irritation in the nose triggers a reflex that forcefully expels air through the nose and mouth.

why do people yawn.a: Yawning is a common reflex involving a deep inhalation and stretching of the mouth and jaw, although its exact biological purpose is not completely understood.

why do people get hiccups.a: Hiccups occur when the diaphragm suddenly contracts involuntarily, followed by rapid closure of the vocal cords.

why do people sweat.a: People sweat primarily to help regulate body temperature by allowing heat to be lost as sweat evaporates from the skin.

why does the heart beat.a: The heart beats to pump blood throughout the body, delivering oxygen and nutrients and carrying away waste products.

why do we have fingerprints.a: Fingerprints are patterns of ridges on the fingers that develop before birth and help improve grip and touch sensitivity.

why is blood red.a: Blood is red because red blood cells contain hemoglobin, a protein containing iron that gives blood its characteristic color.

why do humans have eyebrows.a: Eyebrows help channel sweat and water away from the eyes and also contribute to facial expressions and communication.

why do humans have eyelashes.a: Eyelashes help protect the eyes by detecting and reducing contact with dust, debris, and other particles.

what is evolution.a: Evolution is the change in inherited characteristics of populations across generations.

what is natural selection.a: Natural selection is a process in which inherited traits that improve survival or reproduction can become more common in a population over generations.

what is extinction.a: Extinction occurs when no living individuals of a species remain.

what is a dinosaur.a: Dinosaurs were a diverse group of reptiles that lived for millions of years before most became extinct about 66 million years ago.

what is a fossil.a: A fossil is preserved evidence of ancient life, such as bones, shells, footprints, or impressions.

what is a mammal.a: A mammal is a warm-blooded vertebrate animal characterized by features including hair or fur and the production of milk by females to feed their young.

how do i add players to my guild.q: how do i add players to my guild
how do i add players to my guild.a: Use `.guild invite @user`. They must accept with `.guild accept`. You need to be the guild leader or an officer, and the guild must have free member slots (upgrade HQ to raise the cap).

how do i invite to guild.q: how do i invite to guild
how do i invite to guild.a: Type `.guild invite @user`. The invited player accepts with `.guild accept`. Invites expire after 24 hours.

how does guild work.a: Create one with `.guild create <name>`. Invite members, upgrade HQ for higher member cap, claim territory, and fight other guilds. Check `.guild` for status.

what is heat.a: Heat is the city-wide danger level. Higher heat makes crimes harder and more profitable, and increases wanted gain. It decays over time. Check `.city`.

how do i get out of jail.q: how do i get out of jail
how do i get out of jail.a: Pay bail with `.bail` or try `.escape`. Higher stealth improves escape odds. Being in prison blocks most crime commands.

what is hospital.a: When you lose all 3 hearts you get hospitalized for 10 hours. You can still do businesses, bank, and minigames. Buy a *Heart Shot* from `.shop` (1M) to restore a heart and leave hospital early.

what is heart shot.a: Heart Shot is a shop item costing $1,000,000. It restores 1 heart and instantly clears hospitalization.

how do hearts work.a: You have 3 hearts. Losing fights or taking heavy hits removes hearts. At 0 you are hospitalized for 10h. Heart Shot from the shop restores 1 heart and frees you from hospital.

how does crime work.a: Use `.crime` or `.crime list` to see available crimes. Success gives cash and XP but raises heat/wanted. Higher level and gear improve odds.

how do i join a heist.q: how do i join a heist
how do i join a heist.a: Someone opens a lobby with `.heist` commands, then others join. There are also solo heists. Check `.heists` or the menu for the current list.

what is black market.a: Black Market Takeover is a high-level (70+) district auction and control event. Bid on districts, challenge controllers, and earn titles. Use `.blackmarket`.

how do i change my name.q: how do i change my name
how do i change my name.a: First time is free with `.set name <name>`. After that you need a Name Change Card from `.shop`, then `.set name <newname>`.
